posts.title: This model knows the answer. It just can’t stop thinking.
posts.description: A 0.8B reasoning model scores 8% on MATH-500, and a lot of the time the right answer is sitting in its own scratchpad. It just never stops thinking. Two weeks ago an AI agent got it to 48% by editing its weights. I spent a few days on why it loops, and got to about 50% by ending the thinking for it.

posts.title: One Linear layer broke my INT8 encoder
posts.description: I tried to make a small encoder cheaper to serve. One projection broke the INT8 conversion; batching made the recovery more complicated than its score suggested.

posts.title: The Zero-Shot Plateau
posts.description: My last post made a narrow claim: on a classification taxonomy of my own, a fine-tuned encoder beats the zero-shot “decision models” everyone shipped this autumn by about 30 macro-F1 points, at a fraction of the cost.
